name: Gqom broken kicks (Visco)
desc: Displaced ViscoSpaceDrum kick clusters that never land on a straight four — four different sgubhu cells rotate over 4 cycles, 808 ghost hats pan-drift on a slow sine, ply fills punctuate every 8 bars. Dark Durban club pressure.

code.sparse: s("<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~] [~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ bd ~]>").bank("ViscoSpaceDrum").shape(${drive}).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.5, ${cut}).slow(32)).gain(${gain}*.85).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ bd] [bd ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd bd ~]>").bank("ViscoSpaceDrum").shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR808").gain("[.42 .18 .3 .14]*2").pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)).every(8, x=>x.ply(2))).lpf(${cut}).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ ~ bd bd ~ bd bd] [bd bd ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ bd bd ~ bd bd ~]>").bank("ViscoSpaceDrum").shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)), s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR808").gain("[.4 .15 .28 .12]*4").mask("<1 1 1 0>").pan(cosine.range(.25,.75).slow(16)), s("~ cp ~ [~ cp]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.5).room(.25).every(8, x=>x.fast(2))).lpf(${cut}).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
